topics.name: Investing
topics.description: Putting money into financial assets and cash products to preserve capital, generate income, or grow wealth.

subtopics.name: ETFs and index funds
subtopics.description: Selecting and using ETFs and index funds, including Sparplan, MSCI World, FTSE All-World, S&P 500, and emerging-market funds.

subtopics.name: Individual stocks
subtopics.description: Selecting, valuing, buying, holding, or selling shares in individual companies, including Aktien and Einzelwerte.

subtopics.name: Gold
subtopics.description: Physical gold, gold coins or bars, gold ETCs such as Xetra-Gold, and gold price or inflation-hedge videos.

subtopics.name: Silver
subtopics.description: Physical silver, Silbermünzen or bars, silver ETCs, and silver price or shortage videos.

subtopics.name: Bonds
subtopics.description: Investing in government or corporate bonds and understanding yield, duration, credit risk, Anleihen, and bond funds.

subtopics.name: Savings and deposits
subtopics.description: Using Tagesgeld, Festgeld, savings accounts, and similar low-risk interest-bearing products.

subtopics.name: Bausparvertrag
subtopics.description: Bausparvertrag as a savings contract, including whether the classic Sparmodell is still worthwhile.

subtopics.name: P2P and private credit
subtopics.description: P2P lending platforms such as Loanch, Mintos, Bondora, and Bondora Go & Grow.

subtopics.name: Active funds and robo-advisors
subtopics.description: Using actively managed funds, wealth managers, or automated investment services and evaluating their fees and performance.

subtopics.name: Portfolio strategy
subtopics.description: Asset allocation, diversification, rebalancing, and risk tolerance as the main subject of the video.

subtopics.name: Cryptoassets
subtopics.description: Buying, holding, or evaluating cryptocurrencies and other digital assets as personal investments.

subtopics.name: Leverage and derivatives
subtopics.description: Using options, futures, warrants, leveraged products, margin, or credit to amplify investment exposure and risk.

topics.name: Insurance
topics.description: Managing personal and household risks through appropriate insurance coverage at a reasonable cost.

subtopics.name: Private health insurance (PKV)
subtopics.description: Private Krankenversicherung membership: switching into PKV, contributions, deductibles, Beihilfe, Gesundheitsprüfung, and dedicated PKV versus GKV membership choices.

subtopics.name: Statutory health insurance (GKV)
subtopics.description: Gesetzliche Krankenversicherung: Zusatzbeitrag, Familienversicherung, and staying in or returning to GKV.

subtopics.name: Supplementary health cover
subtopics.description: Krankenzusatzversicherung, Zahnzusatz, Krankenhauszusatz, and other add-on policies on top of GKV.

subtopics.name: Personal liability insurance
subtopics.description: Privathaftpflicht: coverage for accidental harm to other people or their property, including limits and exclusions.

subtopics.name: Disability and income protection
subtopics.description: Berufsunfähigkeit, Erwerbsunfähigkeit, Krankentagegeld, and other cover that protects earned income against incapacity or severe illness.

subtopics.name: Life and survivor protection
subtopics.description: Risikolebensversicherung, funeral cover, and related policies intended to protect dependants after a death.

subtopics.name: Home and belongings insurance
subtopics.description: Hausrat, Wohngebäude, and Elementarversicherung for homes and possessions.

subtopics.name: Legal expenses insurance
subtopics.description: Rechtsschutzversicherung for legal advice, lawyers, and court costs across private, employment, traffic, or housing disputes.

subtopics.name: Motor insurance
subtopics.description: KFZ and Autoversicherung: Haftpflicht, Teilkasko, Vollkasko, deductibles, and no-claims bonuses.

subtopics.name: Travel and specialist insurance
subtopics.description: Travel health, cancellation, pet, device, and other narrowly targeted policies, including whether the coverage is worthwhile.

topics.name: Budgeting and money habits
topics.description: Managing income, spending, saving, and everyday financial decisions to keep household finances sustainable.

subtopics.name: Income and expense tracking
subtopics.description: Recording, categorizing, and reviewing cash flows with a Haushaltsbuch, spreadsheet, or app.

subtopics.name: Envelope method
subtopics.description: Umschlagmethode, cash stuffing, Sparchallenge, and physical or digital envelope systems for allocating cash.

subtopics.name: Budget systems
subtopics.description: Zero-based budgets, 50/30/20, percentage rules, sinking funds, and similar allocation methods other than envelope systems.

subtopics.name: Emergency funds
subtopics.description: Choosing the size, location, and use rules for liquid reserves that cover unexpected costs or income loss.

subtopics.name: Saving goals
subtopics.description: Planning and automating savings for purchases, education, travel, family needs, or other short- and medium-term goals.

subtopics.name: Reducing spending
subtopics.description: Finding unnecessary costs, negotiating bills, changing consumption habits, and evaluating frugality strategies.

subtopics.name: Household financial planning
subtopics.description: Coordinating money between partners or family members, including shared expenses, accounts, and financial responsibilities.

subtopics.name: Psychology of money
subtopics.description: Videos about money mindset, financial anxiety, or the psychology of spending and investing.

topics.name: Banking and payments
topics.description: Videos whose subject is Girokonto, debit or credit cards, Kontowechsel, banking apps, account fees, or fraud and phishing. A passing mention of Konto or Bank is not enough.

subtopics.name: Account comparisons
subtopics.description: Girokonto comparisons, including C24, Trade Republic, neobanks, traditional current accounts, Auslandskonto, fees, and Kontowechsel.

subtopics.name: Credit cards
subtopics.description: Credit cards, bonus programs, cashback, benefits, and card fees.

subtopics.name: Online banking security
subtopics.description: Keeping bank accounts safe, frozen accounts, phishing, and regaining access.

subtopics.name: Banking apps
subtopics.description: Reviewing and comparing banking apps such as Finanzguru and bank-native apps.

topics.name: Retirement
topics.description: Government, employer, and private pension products: gesetzliche Rente, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Riester, Rürup, Altersvorsorgedepot, and private Rentenversicherung. Ordinary ETF or stock investing for later is Investing.

subtopics.name: Statutory pension
subtopics.description: Gesetzliche Rente, Rentenpunkte, Rentenbescheid, Regelaltersgrenze, and public pension forecasts.

subtopics.name: Occupational pension
subtopics.description: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Entgeltumwandlung, employer contributions, portability, and taxation.

subtopics.name: Riester
subtopics.description: Riester-Rente: subsidies, fees, payout rules, and cancel or ripoff videos. Distinct from Rürup contracts and from the Altersvorsorgedepot.

subtopics.name: Ruerup
subtopics.description: Rürup / Basisrente, including eligibility, tax treatment, fees, and payout rules. Distinct from Riester contracts.

subtopics.name: Altersvorsorgedepot
subtopics.description: The proposed AV-Depot / Altersvorsorgedepot, including 2027-dated explainers and critiques. Distinct from Riester and from an ordinary depot.

subtopics.name: Private pension insurance
subtopics.description: Private Rentenversicherung and capital life insurance used to generate retirement income.

subtopics.name: Retirement needs and gaps
subtopics.description: Estimating future expenses, pension income, longevity, inflation, and the amount needed to close a retirement shortfall.

subtopics.name: Retirement withdrawals
subtopics.description: Converting accumulated assets into sustainable income through withdrawals, annuities, or mixed strategies.

subtopics.name: Early and flexible retirement
subtopics.description: Frührente, Rente mit 63, phased retirement, working in retirement, and the resulting benefit adjustments.

topics.name: Taxes
topics.description: Understanding and legally optimizing taxes that affect personal income, assets, investments, and major financial decisions.

subtopics.name: Filing, assessment and tax
subtopics.description: Preparing and filing German personal income tax returns with ELSTER, WISO, Taxfix, or smartsteuer, including deadlines and Finanzamt assessments.

subtopics.name: Deductions and allowances
subtopics.description: Using deductible expenses, lump sums, tax-free allowances, family benefits, and other personal tax relief.

subtopics.name: Investment taxes
subtopics.description: Abgeltungsteuer, Vorabpauschale, Freistellungsauftrag, dividends, fund taxation, crypto gains, and loss offsets.

subtopics.name: Employment and self-employment taxes
subtopics.description: Tax questions involving salaries, benefits, side income, freelancing, business expenses, or mixed employment.

subtopics.name: Property taxes
subtopics.description: Grundsteuer, Grunderwerbsteuer, and other taxes connected with buying, owning, renting, or selling real estate.

subtopics.name: International taxation
subtopics.description: Personal tax residence, foreign income and assets, withholding taxes, and double-taxation issues.

subtopics.name: Tax policy changes
subtopics.description: Legislative reforms, court decisions, thresholds, Neuerungen, and administrative changes that alter household finances.

topics.name: Real estate
topics.description: Buying, financing, owning, renting out, or selling residential real estate as a home or personal investment.

subtopics.name: Buying a home
subtopics.description: Searching for, viewing, negotiating, and completing the purchase of an owner-occupied house or Wohnung, including Nebenkosten and Notar.

subtopics.name: Mortgage financing
subtopics.description: Baufinanzierung, Hypothek, Zinsbindung, Tilgung, Sondertilgung, Vorfälligkeit, Effektivzins, variables Darlehen, 100%-Finanzierung, KfW, affordability, and refinancing.

subtopics.name: Renting versus buying
subtopics.description: Mieten oder kaufen comparisons of remaining a tenant versus purchasing a home.

subtopics.name: Ownership costs
subtopics.description: Kaufnebenkosten, maintenance, Hausgeld, utilities, insurance, and reserves for repairs.

subtopics.name: Building and renovating
subtopics.description: Financial planning for construction, modernization, energy upgrades, subsidies, and cost overruns.

subtopics.name: Rental property investing
subtopics.description: Kapitalanlageimmobilie and Vermietung, including yields, vacancies, tenant issues, and financing risk.

subtopics.name: Selling property
subtopics.description: Valuation, preparation, transaction costs, mortgage settlement, and financial decisions involved in a property sale.

subtopics.name: Car loans
subtopics.description: Getting a car loan, interest rates on car loans

subtopics.name: Credit restructuring
subtopics.description: Taking out loans to finance other loans

subtopics.name: Debt collection
subtopics.description: Inkasso, Pfändung and related

subtopics.name: Credit scoring
subtopics.description: SCHUFA score and other credit requirements
